interface.shortDescription: Reviewed AMSoft workflows in one plugin.
interface.longDescription: A central AMSoft plugin for reviewed agentic workflows, including a Guided Writing Coach that builds paragraphs only from the user's own chat contributions against an outline and detailed reference. WordPress Content is a lightweight workflow independent of Standard Development Workflow: theme, blocks, patterns, layout and copy are prepared with temporary files, verified locally in a browser, applied live with a rollback ready, and rolled back on failed live verification. Software delivery, WordPress DevOps, and optional Git synchronization remain separate capabilities.
